title: H-Bridge Direction and Speed Control
description: Two logic inputs pick a diagonal of switches; a PWM slider sets the speed. The microcontroller never carries motor current.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensors, Displays, Motors, and Robot Chassis

educational.audience: Students adding motors to a robot

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a set of H-bridge control inputs and a PWM duty cycle, the learner demonstrates how DC motor direction and speed are controlled without routing motor current through the microcontroller.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Toggle the two control inputs and drag the PWM duty cycle
pedagogical.assessment: Ask which switches are closed for reverse before toggling anything.
